title.rendered: Mira Vista Golf and Country Club DJ

content.rendered:
Wedding  DJ Reception Schedule

Bride and Groom
Ted Chiao
Miki Ito
Japanese Chinese American Wedding DJ


Traditional Sake Japanese Ceremony by The Bride and Groom. Very Nice !.


Western Wedding Ceremony


Wedding Ceremony with Origami Thrown.


Traditional Japanese Fan Dance Performed by the Brides Mother.


2:30-3:00 Wedding Ceremony (Tim, Gaby, and Ted will greet guests, need to find a place for

Origami cranes toss, flower shower how to do it? Ask Ann)

3:40/3:50 (start) Cocktail Hour (picture time for family and friends)

5:00-5:10 Bridal party entering along with groom and bride’s parents

5:10-5:20 Japanese sake ceremony (p.s. 339do, need to practice)

5:20 Groom’s mother making a toast

5:30 Dinner serve

Best man’s speech

Bride’s best friend speech

6:00 (tentative) Toshiko Japanese dance (need to tell the DJ that we need cassette player)

6:10 Bride changes cloth

6:20 Groom leaves

6:30 re-entrance

6:35 First dance (ask deejay about how to go about with this event. Ted and Miki dance

early arriving guests!

first then follow by after bride and father dance, conclude with groom and

mother dance)

7:50-8:00 Groom and bride’s speech

8:00 Cake cutting

Coffee/tea serve

9:00 Guests leave

______________________________________________________________

Ceremony Music

-Procession…..Canon in D (Johann Pachelbel)

-Bride and Father of Bride entry……Bridal Chorus (Wager)

-Signing of Wedding License…..Jesus, Joy of Man’s Desiring

-Recession….Wedding March (Madelssohn)

-End of ceremony…..When I’m Sixty-Four

Wedding Reception

-Bridal Party Entry…..Happy (Pharrell Williams) Song 12

-Bride and Groom….. Song 28

-Sake Ceremony…..Song 23

-Mother’s Toast…..Song 27

-Best Man’s Speech…..Determine by the DJ

-Bride’s Best Friend’s Speech…..Song 2

-Bride and Groom Re-entry Song…..Marry Me (Bruno Mars) Song 5

-First Dance….. Lovin’you Song 13

-Bride/Father Dance…..Song 26

-Groom/Mother song…..Will sing by Sandy

-Bride’s Speech…..Song 29

-Groom’s Speech…..Determine by the DJ

-Cake Cutting…..Good Time Song 11

-Last Song…..Song 24

 

Bride’s Parents
 
Mr. Koeru Ito  

Mrs.Toshiko Ito

Groom’s Parents
 
Mrs. Tami Kuo Chang  

Mr. Gregory Chang 

Bridal Party
Ms Winnie PI
Mr. Peter PI
Mrs.Yuka Wakatsuki   

Mr. Hiroshi Wakatsuki

Mrs. Gaby Yee
Mr. Tim Yee
Bride and Groom
Ted Chiao
Miki Ito
________________________________________________________________________Here is the new updated list.
Please finalise.
Also add in MC..Mira Vista Golf and Country Club
7901 Cutting Blvd, El Cerrito, CA 94530

3pm – 9pm
_________________________________________________________

3pm
Ceremony Music
sade, By Your Side

-Procession…..Canon in D (Johann Pachelbel)

-Bride and Father of Bride entry……Bridal Chorus (Wager)

-Signing of Wedding License…..Jesus, Joy of Man’s Desiring

-Recession….Wedding March (Madelssohn)

-End of ceremony…..When I’m Sixty-Four

_____________________________________________________________

Wedding Reception
3:40/3:50
jazz cocktail hour
modern jazz or new jazz or both?.
sinatra, elvis, dean martin, peter white, smooth jazz.cant take my eyes of you, cha cha.

Can’t Help Falling In Love-ub40

5-5.10pm -Bridal Party Entry…..Happy (Pharrell Williams) Song 12

-Bride and Groom….. Song 28

5:10-5:20 -Sake Ceremony…..Song 23

5:20 -Mother’s grooms Toast…..Song 27 just play a little bit

5:30 – Dinner served –
-Best Man’s Speech…..Determine by the DJ

-Bride’s Best Friend’s Speech…..Song 2

?-6:00 (tentative) Toshiko Japanese dance (need to tell the DJ that we need cassette player)
??. cassette play song

6:10 Bride changes cloth
6:20 Groom leaves
6:30 -Bride and Groom Re-entry Song…..
Marry Me (Bruno Mars) Song 5

6:35-First Dance….. Lovin’you Song 13
add a second song for first dance,

-Bride/Father Dance…..Song 26

-Groom/Mother song…..Will sing by Sandy

7:50-8:00 -Bride’s Speech…..Song 29

-Groom’s Speech…..spandau ballet

8:00 -Cake Cutting…..Good Time Song 11
Cake cutting
Coffee/tea serve

-Dancing – new old mix of everything, 80s.
brick house, we are family, depeche mode just cant get enough, rihanna we found love, gangnam style, cha cha, ballroom song,
little apple (chinese fast song popular),calvin harris,

-Last Song…..Song 24

_____________________________________________________

play anytime songs

All For Love 4:44 Bryan Adams Anthology

Careless Breath 4:40 Exile Asia
CHANGE 4:34 Monkey Majik ENGLISH BEST
Good Time 3:27 Carly Rae Jepsen,Owl City Good Time

Love Never Felt So Good 4:06 Michael Jackson,Justin Timberlake Love Never Felt So Good
Luv Letter 4:30 DJ OKAWARI MIRROR
One Love People Get Ready 2:49 Bob Marley Legend: The Best Of Bob Marley And The Wailers-Polygram Records
Sex And The City – Movie Theme 0:50 Pfeifer Broz Orchestra Sex And The City – Original Motion Picture Soundtrack
Share My World 5:07 Mary J. Blige Share My World
